task: A baseline Zoom config file exists at /home/user/.config/zoomus.conf. Change autoTurnOffVideo to true so Zoom will turn the camera off whenever a meeting is joined. Save the updated file in place at /home/user/.config/zoomus.conf. Do not change any other keys.

cli_feasibility.translation: Use sed to modify /home/user/.config/zoomus.conf: set [General] autoTurnOffVideo=true
cli_feasibility.reason: CLI agent can directly edit the config file using sed. Single boolean value change is trivial for CLI. Task mentions GUI Settings > Video but CLI is equally viable.
